findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote, get_transcript, query_collection, search_talks · Private data: list_sources, add_source, transcribe, create_collection, add_sources, get_status, get_transcript, query_collection, search_talks · Public sink: query_channel, add_source, quote, transcribe, create_collection, add_sources, query_collection, search_talks · Destructive: query_channel, get_transcript.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote, get_transcript, query_collection, search_talks · Private data: list_sources, add_source, transcribe, create_collection, add_sources, get_status, get_transcript, query_collection, search_talks · Public sink: query_channel, add_source, quote, transcribe, create_collection, add_sources, query_collection, search_talks · Destructive: query_channel, get_transcript

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
